captions.detailed: A dark, matte-black naval swivel deck cannon mounted on a vertical support post. The base features a circular flanged plate with visible mounting bolts, supporting a cylindrical vertical column. At the top of the column, a fork yoke holds a tapered cannon barrel via horizontal trunnion pins, allowing the barrel to elevate and depress, while the yoke itself can rotate horizontally on the post.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a naval-style swivel deck cannon using CadQuery. The model should feature a circular flanged base with bolts, a vertical post, a fork-shaped yoke, and a tapered cannon barrel with a flared muzzle and a rear cascabel knob, allowing for elevation and yaw rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat cylinder combined with smaller circular bolt patterns. Create the vertical post as a cylinder. Build the yoke using a horizontal base plate combined with two vertical rectangular arms with chamfered top corners and trunnion pin holes. Model the barrel as a lofted or unioned set of coaxial cylinders and cones to achieve the tapered profile, adding a flared muzzle cylinder at one end and a spherical cascabel at the breech. Assemble the parts using revolute joints for horizontal yaw rotation at the post-yoke connection and vertical pitch elevation at the trunnion pins.
